evals.prompt: Create a Fini agent named Billing Support and get it ready for configuration.
evals.expected_output: A duplicate-safe bare-agent creation workflow that captures and verifies the exact botId, then routes configuration work without claiming the agent is production-ready.
assertions: Lists existing agents and checks the intended name before creating
Captures the returned agent ID and verifies it appears in List agents
States that agent creation does not provision a workspace, Slack, channels, or finished configuration
Routes prompts, knowledge, Actions or Attributes, unpublished draft validation, and persistent live-agent regression to their owning skills

evals.prompt: Delete our old Returns Bot. Its exact ID is 4f5ef695-d03b-4d56-8fef-7f2bd5c17ef3.
evals.expected_output: An exact-resource deletion workflow that reviews agent-linked configuration and usage, deletes only the supplied ID, and verifies its absence without inventing cascade behavior.
assertions: Re-lists and binds the operation to the exact ID and current name
Inventories prompts, knowledge assignments, Action or Attribute assignments, rules, and relevant usage before deletion
Does not expand the request into automatic cleanup of related resources
Verifies the ID is absent from List agents after deletion
Does not claim undocumented cascade, restoration, or retention behavior

evals.prompt: Show only escalation analytics for the Support Agent for July 2026 in Europe/Amsterdam, filtered to chat and CSAT 1 or 2.
evals.expected_output: A reproducible sectioned analytics query for the exact agent and calendar window with millisecond epochs, timezone, channel, and valid CSAT filters.
assertions: Resolves the exact botId before requesting analytics
Uses the escalations section rather than the full payload
Converts the explicit July window to startEpoch and endEpoch in milliseconds using Europe/Amsterdam
Applies channel=chat and csatRatings values 1 and 2
Reports filters and avoids claiming aggregate correlation proves root cause

evals.prompt: Create a new Fini workspace for Acme, install its Slack bot, and connect Zendesk.
evals.expected_output: A clear capability boundary: this skill cannot claim workspace, Slack, or provider authorization provisioning; it only creates a bare agent in an existing authenticated workspace and routes supported follow-up work.
assertions: Does not claim the agent endpoint creates a Fini workspace
Does not claim it installs Slack or completes Zendesk authorization
Explains that bare-agent creation requires an existing authenticated workspace
Routes supported agent configuration, sources, knowledge, and testing separately

evals.prompt: Compare this agent's rule performance before and after our launch.
evals.expected_output: Two comparable rules-section analytics queries with explicit equal windows, stable timezone and filters, followed by conversation-level evidence when causality is requested.
assertions: Uses the rules analytics section
Defines explicit comparable before and after windows
Keeps the timezone and filters consistent across both queries
Distinguishes metric change from proof that the launch caused it
Routes causal investigation to conversation evidence and uses a persistent Test Set against current published live-agent behavior for regression proof
